device.description: 12-bit 8-channel delta-sigma ADC system monitor with temperature sensor, limit registers and I2C interface
device.note: adc128d818.pdf (SNAS483F) p.4-5 pin functions, p.6 recommended operating conditions, p.9 serial bus timing, p.16 modes of operation and interface, p.17 serial bus address (Table 2), p.17-18 write/read examples (Figures 26-31), p.19-27 register maps (Tables 3-15), p.29-30 output code and interrupts, p.33-34 quick start, POR, configuration, conversion rate (12.2 ms per voltage, 3.6 ms temperature, ~728 ms low power), one-shot

registers.name: CONFIG
registers.note: Table 4: bit 0 START, 1 INT_Enable, 3 INT_Clear, 7 Initialization (self-clearing); bits 2, 4-6 reserved read-only

registers.name: INT_STATUS
registers.note: Table 5: per-channel limit error flags (meaning per mode); read-only, cleared by reading (p.30)

registers.name: INT_MASK
registers.note: Table 6: 1 masks the channel's status from INT; reserved bits depend on the mode

registers.name: CONV_RATE
registers.note: Table 7: bit 0 0 = low power conversion mode, 1 = continuous conversion mode

registers.name: CH_DISABLE
registers.note: Table 8: 1 disables the channel's conversion (meaning per mode)

registers.name: ONE_SHOT
registers.note: Table 9 / p.34: write-only; a write starts one conversion cycle in shutdown or deep shutdown; reads 0

registers.name: DEEP_SHUTDOWN
registers.note: Table 10: bit 0 deep shutdown enable (when START = 0)

registers.name: ADV_CONFIG
registers.note: Table 11: bit 0 external reference enable, bits 2-1 mode select (Mode 0-3)

registers.name: BUSY_STATUS
registers.note: Table 12: bit 0 Busy (converting), bit 1 Not Ready (power-up sequence)

commands.name: Register Address
commands.note: p.16: a write is the address byte, the register address byte, then the data byte; a read returns the register at the internal address (Figures 26-31); 16-bit reading registers read as two bytes, MSB first

pages: p.4-5 (pins), p.6 (ROC: V+ 3.0-5.5 V; SCL, SDA, A0, A1, INT -0.05 to 5.5 V), p.9 (I2C timing), p.16 (Table 1 modes, interface), p.17 (Table 2 addresses 1Dh-37h), p.17-18 (Figures 26-31), p.19 (Table 3 register summary and defaults), p.20-27 (Tables 4-15), p.29 (straight binary DOUT = VIN/VREF x 4096), p.30 (interrupt structure, clearing), p.33-34 (quick start, POR, conversion rate, one-shot, deep shutdown, readings)
notModeled: analog inputs, internal/external reference, single-ended/pseudo-differential modes (ADV_CONFIG is stored only); the temperature sensor: the temperature reading (27h in modes 0, 2, 3) reads 0 (0 C) like every other reading
tri-level address pins: the MID level (A0 or A1 at mid-supply: addresses 1Eh, 2Dh, 2Eh, 2Fh, 36h) cannot be expressed; the table gives the four LOW/HIGH combinations

round-robin monitoring is modeled as one conversion per cycle of all channels: 89 ms in continuous mode (7 x 12.2 ms + 3.6 ms, mode 0 with every channel enabled) and ~728 ms in low power mode; CH_DISABLE and the mode do not change the time
INT_Clear = 1 (its power-on value) also stops the monitoring loop: the model runs continuously while START = 1 regardless of INT_Clear
the one-shot trigger needs bit 0 = 1 in the written value (the datasheet: any write to 09h starts a cycle)
Not Ready (BUSY_STATUS bit 1, set at power-on) is cleared by a conversion cycle that the model starts at power-on (one low-power cycle, ~728 ms; the datasheet: at least 33 ms)
limit comparison, interrupt status flags, INT pin (open-drain, active low), INT_Enable / INT_Clear / mask logic and temperature hysteresis: INT is never driven
Initialization bit (CONFIG bit 7, restores defaults and self-clears) and the reading/status reset on CH_DISABLE or ADV_CONFIG writes; deep shutdown
power-on values of the Channel Readings and Limit Registers are indeterminate (0 used); the alignment of the 12-bit reading in the 16-bit register is not given (the 0 V code is 0 either way)
readings not updated while a bus transaction is in progress; I2C time-out (25-35 ms), fast mode timing limits
